query:
FROM .internal.alerts-security.alerts-default-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T18:35:57Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T19:35:57Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        earliest = MIN(@timestamp),
        latest = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY kibana.alert.rule.name, kibana.alert.severity
| SORT total DESC
| LIMIT 20
